record.title: Structural adhesive bond — two moulded or bought faces joined by a cured bead, where the bead is also the seal
record.why: The GEOMETRY is measured and PASSES on both uses in halo: the carrier's Ø27.60 wall in the shell's Ø27.90 bore is a 0.150 mm radial gap over 2.31 mm of height (198 mm2 of bond area), and the bender's brass face sits 0.050 mm from the shell's flat land, measured part-to-part in design.py. The STRENGTH is CANNOT DETERMINE and stays so: no adhesive has been chosen by part number, no lap-shear test has been run, and no cured assembly exists. Do not read the geometry PASS as a joint that holds.

joins.a: a bonding land on a moulded part (a cylindrical wall, or the flat internal land the bender sits on)
joins.b: the mating land it is bonded into or onto

record.adds_parts_why: this joint consumes no part; it joins two. No fastener, and deliberately so — a screw would cost 1.5-2.5 mm of a 7.98 mm budget and put metal inside Apple's Ø37.31 antenna keep-out (DECISIONS.md D13).
record.standard_why: Bond strength is governed by the adhesive's own datasheet and by surface preparation, neither of which is on this disk. No lap-shear figure is recorded anywhere in this folder and compat.py grades none.
